sourceQuestions.sourceText: Write this sentence again with the correct capital letters. i went to cairo with sara.
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: I went to Cairo with Sara. (I, Cairo and Sara all need capitals.)

sourceQuestions.sourceText: Use First, Then and At last to finish the recount. , I brushed my teeth. , I got into bed. , I fell asleep.
Circle the verb that shows it has already happened. a We go / went to school. b I walk / walked home. c Sara helps / helped me.
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: a went • b walked • c helped

sourceQuestions.sourceText: Add the endings. walk walks walking walked; play; jump (add s, add ing, add ed)
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: plays, playing, played • jumps, jumping, jumped

sourceQuestions.sourceText: Is it a noun or a verb? Write each word in the right box. dog run school jump apple swim
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: Nouns: dog, school, apple • Verbs: run, jump, swim

sourceQuestions.sourceText: Join the two sentences with and. I like juice. I like milk.
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: I like juice and milk. ("I like juice and I like milk." is also right.)

sourceQuestions.sourceText: True or false? Write T or F. a A recount tells about something that has already happened. b A recount uses time words like First and Then. c A recount is about a monster who lives in the washing machine.
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: a T • b T • c F — that is a fantasy story, not a recount.

sourceQuestions.sourceText: Write two sentences about something you did yesterday. Start with Yesterday, I…
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: Two true sentences about yesterday, with past verbs (went, played, ate) and capital letters and full stops.

sourceQuestions.sourceText: A recount tells about something that ( will happen tomorrow ) ( has already happened ) ( could never happen )
Which word always has a capital letter? ( the ) ( and ) ( I )
Yesterday I ___ over the rope. ( jumped ) ( jumping ) ( jumps )
A noun is ( a doing word ) ( a person, place or thing ) ( a full stop )
The word "Then" is a ( name ) ( place ) ( time word )
